title: Anyone else have super powers in Mallworld?
content: In many of my dreams I find that I have these amazing super power or abilities. whatever you want to call them. I've used them within mallworld but also non mallworld dreams. I seem to be able to use them only when I'm being chased or attacked. Doesn't happen all the time but when it does....it's the best feeling ever. I seem to be able to just make things happen. If I'm surround by threats like security, I can easily defeat them by just making small gestures with my hand. As if swatting them away. But I'm also thinking about doing things to them. Like slamming them up against the walls or ceilings. Sometimes I can just make them pass out. Other times I can make them be in pain. All with simple hand gestures. Jedi-like I guess. It doesn't happen all the time. But when it does it's just a rush. I know others have said they fly around. But I think we all have at some point. So anyone have powers like this or different ones?
